Infopark Real Estate Developers Limited became a part of the Promoter Group Entity of the Company w.e.f. February 17, 2026. 9. Saltbox Infrastructure Private Limited became a part of the Promoter Group Entity of the Company w.e.f. March 26, 2026 respectively. 10. Tata Capital Healthcare III General Partners LLP became a part of the Promoter Group Entity of the Company w.e.f. February 20, 2026. 11.
